thread.title: The worldwide detachable tablet market reached 6.5M units in

author: SA Editor Brandy Betz
title: The worldwide detachable tablet market reached 6.5M units in
text:
The worldwide detachable tablet market reached 6.5M units in Q4, up 10.3% on the year according to preliminary IDC data .
Old-fashioned slate tablets shipped 43.1M units in the quarter and 141.7M in the year. 
Market leaders (detachable + slate): Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ), 13.2M units (+0.6% Y/Y; market share: 26.6%); Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN ), 7.7M units (+50.3%; 15.6% share); Samsung ( OTC:SSNNF , OTC:SSNLF ), 7M units (-13%; 14.1% share); Huawei, 3.5M units (+11.9%; 7.1% share); Lenovo ( OTCPK:LNVGY , OTCPK:LNVGF ), 3.1M (-13.1%; 6.2% share). 
Amazon had the largest percentage point gain in market share between years, rising from 9.6% in 2016 to 15.6%. 
Amazon shares are up 1.1% . 
Apple shares are up 0.7% .
